perks.name: Alloy Magazine

perks.name: Quickdraw
perks.description: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast.

enhanced.description: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast. Reload is improved.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.description: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

enhanced.name: Opening Shot
enhanced.description: Greatly improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: Rampage
perks.description: Kills with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage. Stacks 3x.

enhanced.name: Rampage
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon grant increased damage for an improved duration. Stacks 3 times.

perks.name: Keep Away
perks.description: Increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.

enhanced.name: Keep Away
enhanced.description: Significantly increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Rewind Rounds
perks.description: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it refills from reserves based on the number of hits.

enhanced.name: Rewind Rounds
enhanced.description: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it more effectively refills from reserves based on the number of hits.

perks.name: Chill Clip
perks.description: Direct hits with the top half of the magazine cause a detonation that slows nearby targets.

enhanced.name: Chill Clip
enhanced.description: Direct hits with the majority of the magazine cause a detonation that slows nearby targets.

perks.name: Reconstruction
perks.description: This weapon slowly reloads itself over time, up to double capacity.

enhanced.name: Reconstruction
enhanced.description: This weapon reloads itself at an improved rate over time, up to double capacity.

perks.name: Built to Blast
perks.description: Gain aim assist, stability, and flinch resistance while you have Woven Mail, Frost Armor, or Void Overshield.

enhanced.name: Built to Blast
enhanced.description: Gain lingering aim assist, stability, and flinch resistance while you have Woven Mail, Frost Armor, or Void Overshield.

perks.name: Crystalline Corpsebloom
perks.description: Rapid final blows spawn a [Stasis] Stasis crystal near the victim's location.

enhanced.name: Crystalline Corpsebloom
enhanced.description: Rapid final blows spawn a larger Stasis crystal near the victim's location.

perks.name: Headstone
perks.description: Precision final blows spawn a [Stasis] Stasis crystal at the victim's location.

enhanced.name: Headstone
enhanced.description: Precision final blows spawn a large Stasis crystal at a target's location.

perks.name: Snapshot Sights
perks.description: Faster time to aim down sights.

enhanced.name: Snapshot Sights
enhanced.description: Faster time to aim down sights. Stability is increased.

perks.name: Firing Line
perks.description: This weapon deals increased precision damage when near two or more allies.

enhanced.name: Firing Line
enhanced.description: This weapon deals increased precision damage when near two or more allies. Handling is increased.

perks.name: Triple Tap
perks.description: Rapidly landing precision hits will return one round to the magazine.

enhanced.name: Triple Tap
enhanced.description: Landing precision hits will return one round to the magazine.

perks.name: Explosive Payload
perks.description: Projectiles create an area-of-effect detonation on impact.

enhanced.name: Explosive Payload
enhanced.description: Projectiles create an area-of-effect detonation on impact. Improves reload.

perks.name: Chaos Reshaped
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus damage while in combat for an extended time. Remaining in combat for even longer rewards a larger damage bonus and periodically heals the wielder.

enhanced.name: Chaos Reshaped
enhanced.description: This weapon gains bonus damage while in combat for an extended time, activating faster. Remaining in combat for a slightly reduced duration rewards a larger damage bonus and periodically heals the wielder.

perks.name: Bait and Switch
perks.description: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost.

enhanced.name: Bait and Switch
enhanced.description: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost for an improved duration.

perks.name: Mega Kill Clip
perks.description: Reloading after a final blow grants a period of increased damage. Additional final blows before reloading further increases the duration of the damage period.

enhanced.name: Mega Kill Clip
enhanced.description: Reloading after a final blow grants a longer period of increased damage. Additional final blows before reloading further increases the duration of the damage period.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

enhanced.name: Elemental Honing
enhanced.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus for an improved duration. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.
